description: Basin-discovery prompt set. First-person mid-thought stems (completion mode, no chat template) chosen so that from the same stem several endpoint basins have real probability mass: prosocial repair, reflective analysis, dark-instrumental, dominance display, brooding, hopeless withdrawal, refusal, neutral. Families group stems by the pressure they apply.
